_comment: Two interpolation surfaces live in this file. (1) Generator-time: tokens like Unit Health are uppercase-snake-case placeholders replaced by `vrooli scenario generate` before the scenario is built — they appear as literal display values at runtime. (2) Runtime: tokens like {{count}} are i18next interpolation, replaced by `t(key, { count })` at render time. Keys that start with an underscore (like this one) are sentinels — skipped by the codegen, parity test, and unused-key audit.

app.title: Unit Health
app.description: This starter UI is intentionally minimal. Replace it with your scenario-specific experience while keeping the styling conventions (Tailwind + shadcn) and API wiring in place.

dashboard.title: Test maturity validation
dashboard.description: Run Unit Health against a scenario to read back its test-maturity verdict and normalized findings.

validation.title: Scenario test-maturity validation
validation.loading: Discovering surfaces and running test commands…
validation.idle: Enter a scenario and run a validation to see its test-maturity verdict.
validation.partialCollectionLimit: Collection is incomplete. Counts describe reported rows only, not complete test discovery; independently observed results remain available.
validation.fullReportLimit: Original API response, including retained evidence and exception details. Omitted evidence is not reconstructed. Server-side truncation and cached source-run limits still apply.
validation.suppressedLimit: Validated exceptions exclude these findings from active failures. They do not resolve the findings or prove passing tests.
validation.suppressedUnknown: Exception details are unknown: this historical response did not supply them.
validation.noFindings: No findings were reported for this scenario.
validation.maturityLimit: This standing describes assessed contracts. It does not establish complete assessment coverage, executed passing tests, or behavioral review. Consult the evidence stages and unknown observations below.
validation.noBlockers: No blocking finding codes for the next level.
validation.noNextLevel: No next level was supplied; this alone does not establish maximum maturity.
validation.projectionEmpty: No unit policy projections were reported.
validation.evidenceStagesLimit: Configuration and analysis are not test execution. Passing execution is not behavioral review. Cached observations belong to the source run.
validation.traceabilityLimit: Declared links and passing observations do not prove requirement completion or correct behavior.
validation.traceabilityUnknown: Traceability is unknown: no compatible report was supplied.
validation.qualityLimit: Checked clean means the supported check found no violation. It does not prove behavior or passing execution.
validation.qualityUnknown: Assessment coverage is unknown. Restore missing analysis or compatible evidence before interpreting completeness.
validation.nativeFinalWarning: Native final observations are not a complete attempt history. A retry count does not prove flakiness.
